purpose: Test one bounded repair of the V91/V92 failure: schedule only the parent-complete ready frontier in shortest-remaining-workflow-first order while retaining each scenario's frozen native expert score and the V92 strict per-player guard.

corrected_V91_V92_diagnosis.correction_to_V92_plan_diagnosis: The 396 V91 accepted windows were operational no-ops. Their proposal_assignment_hash, solver_initial_assignment_hash, and dispatched assignment_hash were equal. The previously reported assignment changes came from comparing against initial_assignment_hash, which belongs to the policy-independent offline-reference initializer rather than the operational native initializer.
corrected_V91_V92_diagnosis.conclusion: V91 and V92 both dispatch the eager native initializer exactly. The strict guard correctly removes floating-point no-op acceptances but cannot improve throughput or QPR. The next bounded intervention must change the initializer's workflow frontier/order, not guard tolerances or outcome-dependent weights.

independent_mechanistic_evidence.V58_relevant_result: On a separately preregistered homogeneous cohort, SRPT-ready OCS was the unique high-load winner over all advanced baselines in throughput and both QPR conventions; it also materially improved low/middle throughput-QPR tradeoffs.
independent_mechanistic_evidence.V60_relevant_result: On a separately preregistered heterogeneous cohort, all SRPT-ready middle candidates exceeded the frozen throughput threshold and the mechanism closed the low-load group, supporting ready-frontier workflow completion as a cross-topology intervention.

mechanism.family: scenario-native expert over parent-complete SRPT-ready players with the unchanged V92 strict guard
mechanism.E3_definition: Collect only functions whose parents have completed; order requests by ascending outcome-blind unfinished CPU plus cold-start plus transfer work and functions by descending critical-path rank; sequentially place them with the exact OCS-P score and 64-entry per-function placement history; retain the V92 paper-welfare, every-player nonworsening, at-least-one-player strict guard.
mechanism.E4_definition: Collect only functions whose parents have completed and apply the same SRPT order; retain Jiagu-P's 20-window all-unscheduled demand forecast, demand-sized candidate width, and exact container/utilization/task score; retain the V92 strict guard.
mechanism.single_intended_change_from_V92: The operational player frontier changes from parents-scheduled for E3 and all-unscheduled for E4 to parents-completed for both, and the operational player order becomes SRPT/critical-path. Exact expert score context, feasibility, paper utility, offline reference objective, common HPA, workload tapes, and guard rule remain fixed.

targeted_tests_required: both profiles use deterministic SRPT order
Jiagu forecast input remains all-unscheduled while scheduled players are ready-only

training_gate.per_scenario_rule: The complete E713-E715 arithmetic mean must be finite and strictly greater than the frozen maximum advanced-baseline mean for all three metrics; ties fail.
training_gate.joint_rule: All four scenarios must pass before any V93 confirmation plan may be written or E716-E718 may be opened.
training_gate.blindness_rule: Build all 12 references and run all 12 processes before producing one result-blind audit over identities, hashes, attempt counts, QC, pairing, reference provenance, exact coverage, and unopened confirmation inputs. Reveal performance exactly once only after that audit passes.
training_gate.failure_action: Retain the complete V93 cohort, do not consume E716-E718, do not selectively rerun, and return to mechanism diagnosis.
training_gate.success_action: Freeze both V93 profiles and binary without further tuning, preregister exactly E716-E718, and require a separate blind confirmation audit before paper-group closure.
